items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Phineas’ house all the time and eat up Mamma Rose’s food

ctx.x: You know, he’s trying to learn some music. And he’d come over to Phineas’ house all the time and eat up Mamma Rose’s food and stuff like that, you know.
What? I mean, Phineas is like a miracle to me.
